
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/axmes/p/20153782" title="发布于 2026-05-25 14:02">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">聊一聊 MES系统如何实现多种标签打印并支持不同打印机</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="主页" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525120416222-1638172220.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">在实际生产过程中，同一道工序往往需要打印多种规格的标签，例如彩盒标签与卡通标签。这些标签的格式和纸张规格通常不同，而纸张规格的差异也意味着需要使用不同的打印机。为此，MES 系统通过全局监听打印任务，并支持针对不同打印任务灵活配置对应的打印机，从而实现高度可配置的打印管理。所有打印数据均来源于服务端，模板文件中仅需定义变量即可。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">1.制作模板文件，这里需要用到bartender软件，模板做成什么样，MES打印出来就是什么样子，MES负责将真实的数据放进模板里面打印出来。</span></p>
<p><img alt="模板1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525120310236-1591605520.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">2.创建打印服务程序，用来监听客户端的打印请求，关键代码如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ax_mes_print.Model;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ax_mes_print.Service;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CartonPrintService : IPrintService
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpHelper _httpHelper;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ILogger&lt;CartonPrintService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _logger;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BartenderLabelHelper _bartenderLabelHelper;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> folderName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Carton</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> CartonPrintService(HttpHelper httpHelper, ILogger&lt;CartonPrintService&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger, BartenderLabelHelper bartenderLabelHelper)
    {
        _httpHelper </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> httpHelper;
        _logger </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger;
        _bartenderLabelHelper </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bartenderLabelHelper;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;PrintResponse&gt; ExecutePrintAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> printParameter)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> requestParameter =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DeserializePrintRequest(printParameter);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (requestParameter == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> PrintResponse.Error(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">打印参数有误！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
 

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestParameter.CartonSN))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> PrintResponse.Error(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">卡通箱号不能为空！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> LabelTemplateInfoList = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QueryLabelTemplateInfoAsync(requestParameter.ProductCode);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (LabelTemplateInfoList.Count == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> PrintResponse.Error(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找卡通模板文件,请先上传！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cartonDataData = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QueryCartonDataAsync(requestParameter.CartonSN);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (cartonDataData == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || cartonDataData.Item2.Length == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> PrintResponse.Error(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到卡通数据,打印失败！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> directory =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileHelper.CreateOrDeleteFolder(folderName);


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LabelTemplateInfoList)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _httpHelper.DownloadFileAsync(item.AccessUrl, folderName, item.FileName);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> printReuslt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _bartenderLabelHelper.BartenderPrint(SetPrintName(requestParameter.PrintName), Path.Combine(directory, item.FileName), cartonDataData.Item1, cartonDataData.Item2);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (printReuslt != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PrintResponse.Error(printReuslt);
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> PrintResponse.Success(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">打印命令发送成功,请查看打印机！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> CartonPrintWebSocketRequest? DeserializePrintRequest(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> printParameter)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(printParameter))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> request = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject&lt;CartonPrintWebSocketRequest&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(printParameter);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (request <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> request;

    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;CartonDataData&gt; QueryCartonDataAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cartonSN)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queryCartonDataResponse = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> queryCartonDataResponse.Data;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;List&lt;LabelTemplateInfo&gt;&gt; QueryLabelTemplateInfoAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> productCode)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queryLabelTemplateInfoResponse = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> queryLabelTemplateInfoResponse.Data;
    }

    
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">3.启动 MES 打印服务，该服务程序会监听客户端的打印请求，然后将打印任务传递给打印机。</span></p>
<p><img alt="打印服务" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525120650387-340833571.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4.在 MES 里面启动连接打印机，根据打印内容不同可以选择不同的打印机，如果忘了选择打印机，则系统以默认打印机为准.</p>
<p><img alt="打印服务关闭" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525132143261-1857661674.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="打印服务连接失败" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525132157760-591141933.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="打印服务已连接" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525132209943-934915172.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;如图所示，我们在配置页面根据不同的打印类型设置了不同的打印机，当页面显示已连接的时候，MES通过打印服务将需要打印的内容传递给打印机，完成打印。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="112233" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3331123/202605/3331123-20260525135248042-1498033243.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)"><strong><span style="font-size: 18px">大家如有更好的方案，欢迎一起讨论！！</span></strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
